verses.en: And when Rachel saw that she bare Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister; and said unto Jacob, Give me children, or else I die.
verses.pt: Vendo Raquel que não dava filhos a Jacó, teve inveja de sua irmã, e disse a Jacó: Dá-me filhos, senão eu morro.
verses.en_web: When Rachel saw that she bore Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister. She said to Jacob, “Give me children, or else I will die.”
verses.en_bbe: Now Rachel, because she had no children, was full of envy of her sister; and she said to Jacob, If you do not give me children I will not go on living.

verses.en: And Jacob’s anger was kindled against Rachel: and he said, Am I in God’s stead, who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb?
verses.pt: Então se acendeu a ira de Jacó contra Raquel; e disse: Porventura estou eu no lugar de Deus que te impediu o fruto do ventre?
verses.en_web: Jacob’s anger burned against Rachel, and he said, “Am I in God’s place, who has withheld from you the fruit of the womb?”
verses.en_bbe: But Jacob was angry with Rachel, and said, Am I in the place of God, who has kept your body from having fruit?

verses.en: And she said, Behold my maid Bilhah, go in unto her; and she shall bear upon my knees that I may also have children by her.
verses.pt: Respondeu ela: Eis aqui minha serva Bila; recebe-a por mulher, para que ela dê à luz sobre os meus joelhos, e eu deste modo tenha filhos por ela.
verses.en_web: She said, “Behold, my maid Bilhah. Go in to her, that she may bear on my knees, and I also may obtain children by her.”
verses.en_bbe: Then she said, Here is my servant Bilhah, go in to her, so that she may have a child on my knees, and I may have a family by her.

verses.en: And she gave him Bilhah her handmaid to wife: and Jacob went in unto her.
verses.pt: Assim lhe deu a Bila, sua serva, por mulher; e Jacó a conheceu.
verses.en_web: She gave him Bilhah her servant as wife, and Jacob went in to her.
verses.en_bbe: So she gave him her servant Bilhah as a wife, and Jacob went in to her.

verses.en: And Bilhah conceived, and bare Jacob a son.
verses.pt: Bila concebeu e deu à luz um filho a Jacó.
verses.en_web: Bilhah conceived, and bore Jacob a son.
verses.en_bbe: And Bilhah became with child, and gave birth to a son.

verses.en: And Rachel said, God hath judged me, and hath also heard my voice, and hath given me a son: therefore called she his name Dan.
verses.pt: Então disse Raquel: Julgou-me Deus; ouviu a minha voz e me deu um filho; pelo que lhe chamou Dã.
verses.en_web: Rachel said, “God has judged me, and has also heard my voice, and has given me a son.” Therefore called she his name Dan.
verses.en_bbe: Then Rachel said, God has been my judge, and has given ear to my voice, and has given me a son; so he was named Dan.

verses.en: And Bilhah Rachel’s maid conceived again, and bare Jacob a second son.
verses.pt: E Bila, serva de Raquel, concebeu outra vez e deu à luz um segundo filho a Jacó.
verses.en_web: Bilhah, Rachel’s servant, conceived again, and bore Jacob a second son.
verses.en_bbe: And again Bilhah, Rachel's servant, was with child, and gave birth to a second son.

verses.en: And Rachel said, With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and I have prevailed: and she called his name Naphtali.
verses.pt: Então disse Raquel: Com grandes lutas tenho lutado com minha irmã, e tenho vencido; e chamou-lhe Naftali.
verses.en_web: Rachel said, “I have wrestled with my sister with mighty wrestlings, and have prevailed.” She named him Naphtali.
verses.en_bbe: And Rachel said, I have had a great fight with my sister, and I have overcome her: and she gave the child the name Naphtali.

verses.en: When Leah saw that she had left bearing, she took Zilpah her maid, and gave her Jacob to wife.
verses.pt: Também Léia, vendo que cessara de ter filhos, tomou a Zilpa, sua serva, e a deu a Jacó por mulher.
verses.en_web: When Leah saw that she had finished bearing, she took Zilpah, her servant, and gave her to Jacob as a wife.
verses.en_bbe: When it was clear to Leah that she would have no more children for a time, she gave Zilpah, her servant, to Jacob as a wife.

verses.en: And Zilpah Leah’s maid bare Jacob a son.
verses.pt: E Zilpa, serva de Léia, deu à luz um filho a Jacó.
verses.en_web: Zilpah, Leah’s servant, bore Jacob a son.
verses.en_bbe: And Zilpah, Leah's servant, gave birth to a son.

verses.en: And Leah said, A troop cometh: and she called his name Gad.
verses.pt: Então disse Léia: Afortunada! e chamou-lhe Gade.
verses.en_web: Leah said, “How fortunate!” She named him Gad.
verses.en_bbe: And Leah said, It has gone well for me: and she gave him the name Gad.

verses.en: And Zilpah Leah’s maid bare Jacob a second son.
verses.pt: Depois Zilpa, serva de Léia, deu à luz um segundo filho a Jacó.
verses.en_web: Zilpah, Leah’s servant, bore Jacob a second son.
verses.en_bbe: And Zilpah, Leah's servant, gave birth to a second son.

verses.en: And Leah said, Happy am I, for the daughters will call me blessed: and she called his name Asher.
verses.pt: Então disse Léia: Feliz sou eu! porque as filhas me chamarão feliz; e chamou-lhe Aser.
verses.en_web: Leah said, “Happy am I, for the daughters will call me happy.” She named him Asher.
verses.en_bbe: And Leah said, Happy am I! and all women will give witness to my joy: and she gave him the name Asher.

verses.en: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them unto his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, Give me, I pray thee, of thy son’s mandrakes.
verses.pt: Ora, saiu Rúben nos dias da ceifa do trigo e achou mandrágoras no campo, e as trouxe a Léia, sua mãe. Então disse Raquel a Léia: Dá-me, peço, das mandrágoras de teu filho.
verses.en_web: Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them to his mother, Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, “Please give me some of your son’s mandrakes.”
verses.en_bbe: Now at the time of the grain-cutting, Reuben saw some love-fruits in the field, and took them to his mother Leah. And Rachel said to her, Let me have some of your son's love-fruits.

verses.en: And she said unto her, Is it a small matter that thou hast taken my husband? and wouldest thou take away my son’s mandrakes also? And Rachel said, Therefore he shall lie with thee to night for thy son’s mandrakes.
verses.pt: Ao que lhe respondeu Léia: É já pouco que me hajas tirado meu marido? queres tirar também as mandrágoras de meu filho? Prosseguiu Raquel: Por isso ele se deitará contigo esta noite pelas mandrágoras de teu filho.
verses.en_web: She said to her, “Is it a small matter that you have taken away my husband? Would you take away my son’s mandrakes, also?” Rachel said, “Therefore he will lie with you tonight for your son’s mandrakes.”
verses.en_bbe: But Leah said to her, Is it a small thing that you have taken my husband from me? and now would you take my son's love-fruits? Then Rachel said, You may have him tonight in exchange for your son's love-fruits.

verses.en: And Jacob came out of the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, Thou must come in unto me; for surely I have hired thee with my son’s mandrakes. And he lay with her that night.
verses.pt: Quando, pois, Jacó veio à tarde do campo, saiu-lhe Léia ao encontro e disse: Hás de estar comigo, porque certamente te aluguei pelas mandrágoras de meu filho. E com ela deitou-se Jacó aquela noite.
verses.en_web: Jacob came from the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, “You must come in to me; for I have surely hired you with my son’s mandrakes.” He lay with her that night.
verses.en_bbe: In the evening, when Jacob came in from the field, Leah went out to him and said, Tonight you are to come to me, for I have given my son's love-fruits as a price for you. And he went in to her that night.

verses.en: And God hearkened unto Leah, and she conceived, and bare Jacob the fifth son.
verses.pt: E ouviu Deus a Léia, e ela concebeu e deu a Jacó um quinto filho.
verses.en_web: God listened to Leah, and she conceived, and bore Jacob a fifth son.
verses.en_bbe: And God gave ear to her and she became with child, and gave Jacob a fifth son.

verses.en: And Leah said, God hath given me my hire, because I have given my maiden to my husband: and she called his name Issachar.
verses.pt: Então disse Léia: Deus me tem dado o meu galardão, porquanto dei minha serva a meu marido. E chamou ao filho Issacar.
verses.en_web: Leah said, “God has given me my hire, because I gave my servant to my husband.” She named him Issachar.
verses.en_bbe: Then Leah said, God has made payment to me for giving my servant-girl to my husband: so she gave her son the name Issachar.

verses.en: And Leah conceived again, and bare Jacob the sixth son.
verses.pt: Concebendo Léia outra vez, deu a Jacó um sexto filho;
verses.en_web: Leah conceived again, and bore a sixth son to Jacob.
verses.en_bbe: And again Leah became with child, and she gave Jacob a sixth son.

verses.en: And Leah said, God hath endued me with a good dowry; now will my husband dwell with me, because I have born him six sons: and she called his name Zebulun.
verses.pt: e disse: Deus me deu um excelente dote; agora morará comigo meu marido, porque lhe tenho dado seis filhos. E chamou-lhe Zebulom.
verses.en_web: Leah said, “God has endowed me with a good dowry. Now my husband will live with me, because I have borne him six sons.” She named him Zebulun.
verses.en_bbe: And she said, God has given me a good bride-price; now at last will I have my husband living with me, for I have given him six sons: and she gave him the name Zebulun.

verses.en: And afterwards she bare a daughter, and called her name Dinah.
verses.pt: Depois. disto deu à luz uma filha, e chamou-lhe Diná.
verses.en_web: Afterwards, she bore a daughter, and named her Dinah.
verses.en_bbe: After that she had a daughter, to whom she gave the name Dinah.

verses.en: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.
verses.pt: Também lembrou-se Deus de Raquel, ouviu-a e a tornou fecunda.
verses.en_web: God remembered Rachel, and God listened to her, and opened her womb.
verses.en_bbe: Then God gave thought to Rachel, and hearing her prayer he made her fertile.

verses.en: And she conceived, and bare a son; and said, God hath taken away my reproach:
verses.pt: De modo que ela concebeu e deu à luz um filho, e disse: Tirou-me Deus o opróbrio.
verses.en_web: She conceived, bore a son, and said, “God has taken away my reproach.”
verses.en_bbe: And she was with child, and gave birth to a son: and she said, God has taken away my shame.

verses.en: And she called his name Joseph; and said, The LORD shall add to me another son.
verses.pt: E chamou-lhe José, dizendo: Acrescente-me o Senhor ainda outro filho.
verses.en_web: She named him Joseph, saying, “May Yahweh add another son to me.”
verses.en_bbe: And she gave him the name Joseph, saying, May the Lord give me another son.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Rachel had born Joseph, that Jacob said unto Laban, Send me away, that I may go unto mine own place, and to my country.
verses.pt: Depois que Raquel deu à luz a José, disse Jacó a Labão: Despede-me a fim de que eu vá para meu lugar e para minha terra.
verses.en_web: When Rachel had borne Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, “Send me away, that I may go to my own place, and to my country.
verses.en_bbe: Now after the birth of Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, Let me go away to my place and my country.

verses.en: Give me my wives and my children, for whom I have served thee, and let me go: for thou knowest my service which I have done thee.
verses.pt: Dá-me as minhas mulheres, e os meus filhos, pelas quais te tenho servido, e deixame ir; pois tu sabes o serviço que te prestei.
verses.en_web: Give me my wives and my children for whom I have served you, and let me go; for you know my service with which I have served you.”
verses.en_bbe: Give me my wives and my children, for whom I have been your servant, and let me go: for you have knowledge of all the work I have done for you.

verses.en: And Laban said unto him, I pray thee, if I have found favour in thine eyes, tarry: for I have learned by experience that the LORD hath blessed me for thy sake.
verses.pt: Labão lhe respondeu: Se tenho achado graça aos teus olhos, fica comigo; pois tenho percebido que o Senhor me abençoou por amor de ti.
verses.en_web: Laban said to him, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, stay here, for I have divined that Yahweh has blessed me for your sake.”
verses.en_bbe: And Laban said, If you will let me say so, do not go away; for I have seen by the signs that the Lord has been good to me because of you.

verses.en: And he said, Appoint me thy wages, and I will give it.
verses.pt: E disse mais: Determina-me o teu salário, que to darei.
verses.en_web: He said, “Appoint me your wages, and I will give it.”
verses.en_bbe: Say then what your payment is to be and I will give it.

verses.en: And he said unto him, Thou knowest how I have served thee, and how thy cattle was with me.
verses.pt: Ao que lhe respondeu Jacó: Tu sabes como te hei servido, e como tem passado o teu gado comigo.
verses.en_web: He said to him, “You know how I have served you, and how your livestock have fared with me.
verses.en_bbe: Then Jacob said, You have seen what I have done for you, and how your cattle have done well under my care.

verses.en: For it was little which thou hadst before I came, and it is now increased unto a multitude; and the LORD hath blessed thee since my coming: and now when shall I provide for mine own house also?
verses.pt: Porque o pouco que tinhas antes da minha vinda tem se multiplicado abundantemente; e o Senhor te tem abençoado por onde quer que eu fui. Agora, pois, quando hei de trabalhar também por minha casa?
verses.en_web: For it was little which you had before I came, and it has increased to a multitude. Yahweh has blessed you wherever I turned. Now when will I provide for my own house also?”
verses.en_bbe: For before I came you had little, and it has been greatly increased; and the Lord has given you a blessing in everything I have done; but when am I to do something for my family?

verses.en: And he said, What shall I give thee? And Jacob said, Thou shalt not give me any thing: if thou wilt do this thing for me, I will again feed and keep thy flock:
verses.pt: Insistiu Labão: Que te darei? Então respondeu Jacó: Não me darás nada; tornarei a apascentar e a guardar o teu rebanho se me fizeres isto:
verses.en_web: He said, “What shall I give you?” Jacob said, “You shall not give me anything. If you will do this thing for me, I will again feed your flock and keep it.
verses.en_bbe: And Laban said, What am I to give you? And Jacob said, Do not give me anything; but I will again take up the care of your flock if you will only do this for me:

verses.en: I will pass through all thy flock to day, removing from thence all the speckled and spotted cattle, and all the brown cattle among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats: and of such shall be my hire.
verses.pt: Passarei hoje por todo o teu rebanho, separando dele todos os salpicados e malhados, e todos os escuros entre as ovelhas, e os malhados e salpicados entre as cabras; e isto será o meu salário.
verses.en_web: I will pass through all your flock today, removing from there every speckled and spotted one, and every black one among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats. This will be my hire.
verses.en_bbe: Let me go through all your flock today, taking out from among them all the sheep which are marked or coloured or black, and all the marked or coloured goats: these will be my payment.

verses.en: So shall my righteousness answer for me in time to come, when it shall come for my hire before thy face: every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and brown among the sheep, that shall be counted stolen with me.
verses.pt: De modo que responderá por mim a minha justiça no dia de amanhã, quando vieres ver o meu salário assim exposto diante de ti: tudo o que não for salpicado e malhado entre as cabras e escuro entre as ovelhas, esse, se for achado comigo, será tido por furtado.
verses.en_web: So my righteousness will answer for me hereafter, when you come concerning my hire that is before you. Every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and black among the sheep, that might be with me, will be considered stolen.”
verses.en_bbe: And so you will be able to put my honour to the test in time to come; if you see among my flocks any goats which are not marked or coloured, or any sheep which is not black, you may take me for a thief.

verses.en: And Laban said, Behold, I would it might be according to thy word.
verses.pt: Concordou Labão, dizendo: Seja conforme a tua palavra.
verses.en_web: Laban said, “Behold, let it be according to your word.”
verses.en_bbe: And Laban said, Let it be as you say.

verses.en: And he removed that day the he goats that were ringstraked and spotted, and all the she goats that were speckled and spotted, and every one that had some white in it, and all the brown among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.
verses.pt: E separou naquele mesmo dia os bodes listrados e malhados e todas as cabras salpicadas e malhadas, tudo em que havia algum branco, e todos os escuros entre os cordeiros e os deu nas mãos de seus filhos;
verses.en_web: That day, he removed the male goats that were streaked and spotted, and all the female goats that were speckled and spotted, every one that had white in it, and all the black ones among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.
verses.en_bbe: So that day he took all the he-goats which were banded or coloured, and all the she-goats which were marked or coloured or had white marks, and all the black sheep, and gave them into the care of his sons;

verses.en: And he set three days journey betwixt himself and Jacob: and Jacob fed the rest of Laban’s flocks.
verses.pt: e pôs três dias de caminho entre si e Jacó; e Jacó apascentava o restante dos rebanhos de Labão.
verses.en_web: He set three days’ journey between himself and Jacob, and Jacob fed the rest of Laban’s flocks.
verses.en_bbe: And sent them three days' journey away: and Jacob took care of the rest of Laban's flock.

verses.en: And Jacob took him rods of green poplar, and of the hazel and chesnut tree; and pilled white strakes in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.
verses.pt: Então tomou Jacó varas verdes de estoraque, de amendoeira e de plátano e, descascando nelas riscas brancas, descobriu o branco que nelas havia;
verses.en_web: Jacob took to himself rods of fresh poplar, almond, plane tree, peeled white streaks in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.
verses.en_bbe: Then Jacob took young branches of trees, cutting off the skin so that the white wood was seen in bands.

verses.en: And he set the rods which he had pilled before the flocks in the gutters in the watering troughs when the flocks came to drink, that they should conceive when they came to drink.
verses.pt: e as varas que descascara pôs em frente dos rebanhos, nos cochos, isto é, nos bebedouros, onde os rebanhos bebiam; e conceberam quando vinham beber.
verses.en_web: He set the rods which he had peeled opposite the flocks in the gutters in the watering-troughs where the flocks came to drink. They conceived when they came to drink.
verses.en_bbe: And he put the banded sticks in the drinking-places where the flock came to get water; and they became with young when they came to the water.

verses.en: And the flocks conceived before the rods, and brought forth cattle ringstraked, speckled, and spotted.
verses.pt: Os rebanhos concebiam diante das varas, e as ovelhas davam crias listradas, salpicadas e malhadas.
verses.en_web: The flocks conceived before the rods, and the flocks produced streaked, speckled, and spotted.
verses.en_bbe: And because of this, the flock gave birth to young which were marked with bands of colour.

verses.en: And Jacob did separate the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the ringstraked, and all the brown in the flock of Laban; and he put his own flocks by themselves, and put them not unto Laban’s cattle.
verses.pt: Então separou Jacó os cordeiros, e fez os rebanhos olhar para os listrados e para todos os escuros no rebanho de Labão; e pôs seu rebanho à parte, e não pôs com o rebanho de Labão.
verses.en_web: Jacob separated the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the streaked and all the black in the flock of Laban: and he put his own droves apart, and didn’t put them into Laban’s flock.
verses.en_bbe: These lambs Jacob kept separate; and he put his flock in a place by themselves and not with Laban's flock.

verses.en: And it came to pass, whensoever the stronger cattle did conceive, that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the cattle in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods.
verses.pt: e todas as vezes que concebiam as ovelhas fortes, punha Jacó as varas nos bebedouros, diante dos olhos do rebanho, para que concebessem diante das varas;
verses.en_web: Whenever the stronger of the flock conceived, Jacob laid the rods in front of the eyes of the flock in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods;
verses.en_bbe: And whenever the stronger ones of the flock became with young, Jacob put the sticks in front of them in the drinking-places, so that they might become with young when they saw the sticks.

verses.en: But when the cattle were feeble, he put them not in: so the feebler were Laban’s, and the stronger Jacob’s.
verses.pt: mas quando era fraco o rebanho, ele não as punha. Assim as fracas eram de Labão, e as fortes de Jacó.
verses.en_web: but when the flock were feeble, he didn’t put them in. So the feebler were Laban’s, and the stronger Jacob’s.
verses.en_bbe: But when the flocks were feeble, he did not put the sticks before them; so that the feebler flocks were Laban's and the stronger were Jacob's.

verses.en: And the man increased exceedingly, and had much cattle, and maidservants, and menservants, and camels, and asses.
verses.pt: E o homem se enriqueceu sobremaneira, e teve grandes rebanhos, servas e servos, camelos e jumentos.
verses.en_web: The man increased exceedingly, and had large flocks, female servants and male servants, and camels and donkeys.
verses.en_bbe: So Jacob's wealth was greatly increased; he had great flocks and women-servants and men-servants and camels and asses.
